window.note: Shape/dtype sampled from one representative .mat per activity; all windows are expected to match.

leakage_check.leakage_reason: Zero split-relative path overlap is necessary but not sufficient for zero leakage. CSI-content duplicates and source-row overlap remain to be checked.
leakage_check.csi_content_check_note: CSI-content comparison performed only on split-relative path matches for classes A/B/C. Loading every file is expensive; a full all-pairs content hash would require reading the entire dataset.
leakage_check.source_row_overlap_note: Original source-row indices are not stored in the .mat batch files (they contain only csi_mon). Overlapping source-row intervals cannot be determined without re-decoding the PCAP or the original full-length MAT files. Status: UNVERIFIED.
leakage_check.method_note: Leakage is assessed on three levels: (1) full relative path, (2) split-relative path (strip 'Slots/<split>/' prefix), and (3) exact CSI-content comparison on split-relative matches. Source-row overlap cannot be determined from .mat files alone (they store only csi_mon). Overall status is 'not_fully_verified' until all checks are complete.
